product_overview: A local-first worldbuilding application for writers and game designers that lets users create and persist projects, manage characters and traits, visualize relationships, and procedurally generate editable fantasy maps. The PRD files supplied contained unrelated contact-card images, so this specification is derived from the provided codebase summary.
core_goals: Create and persist multiple story projects locally
Add and manage characters and trait data within a project
Define and visualize relationships between characters
Procedurally generate and edit fantasy maps and save them with a project

features.name: Project Management
features.description: Create, save, open and persist projects locally so users can switch between story projects on their device.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Create a new project -> Enter project name -> Save project -> Navigate to /project-editor -> See new project content loaded

Navigate to / -> Create a new project -> Enter blank project name -> Attempt to save -> See validation error about required name -> Enter valid project name -> Save project -> Navigate to /project-editor -> See project content loaded

features.name: Character Management
features.description: Add characters to a project, assign traits, and define relationships between characters; changes persist to the local project.
user_flows: Navigate to /project-editor -> Add new character -> Assign traits to the character -> Add relationship to other character in the same project -> Save changes -> See character and relationship listed in project

Navigate to /project-editor -> Add new character -> Enter a name that duplicates an existing character -> Attempt to save changes -> See validation message about duplicate name -> Edit name to be unique -> Save changes -> See updated character list

features.name: Relationship Visualization
features.description: Explore an interactive relationship chart that displays character nodes and labeled connections for the active project.
user_flows: Navigate to /relation-chart -> See relationship graph for active project -> Click a node to inspect its connections -> View labels on edges and node details -> Navigate to /project-editor to edit related characters

Navigate to /relation-chart -> See message or empty state indicating no relationships exist -> Navigate to /project-editor -> Add relationship between characters -> Navigate back to /relation-chart -> See updated relationship graph

features.name: Fantasy Map Generation
features.description: Procedurally generate terrain, edit map features (rivers, lakes), and save the resulting map into the project.
user_flows: Navigate to /map-view -> Generate terrain for the project map -> Edit rivers and lakes on the generated map -> Save map -> See map persisted with the project
Navigate to /map-view -> Attempt to save without generated terrain -> See prompt to generate terrain first -> Generate terrain -> Edit features -> Save map -> See map persisted with the project
